act.name: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021
act.source_name: Reserve Bank of India Official Portal
act.description: Integrated scheme by Reserve Bank of India providing free, single-window redressal for grievances against RBI regulated entities including banks, NBFCs, and payment system providers.

sections.title: Grounds of Complaint for Banking and Cyber Transaction Disputes
sections.chapter: Chapter III - Procedure for Redressal of Grievance
sections.text: Any customer aggrieved by an act or omission of a Regulated Entity (bank, NBFC, payment gateway) resulting in deficiency in service, including unauthorized electronic funds transfer, non-reversal of failed ATM/UPI transactions within specified turnaround time, or unauthorized charges, may file a complaint before the RBI Ombudsman.
sections.plain_language_summary: Bank customers can file free complaints with the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in for unauthorized account deductions, failed UPI transactions, or bank negligence.
